en.description:
Fidgeting, reimagined. Fidgetable is a beautiful haptic app designed to help you focus, relax, and find joy in tactile digital interactions. Built seamlessly for iOS, it combines elegant design with shockingly deep customization to give you a sensory experience that feels amazing right out of the box, and can be tailored entirely to you.

Whether you need a simple distraction while working or a deeply customizable sensory tool, Fidgetable delivers satisfying haptics right to your fingertips. And the best part? There are absolutely no ads. Ever.

SIMPLE & SATISFYING CORE FEATURES
- 12+ Unique Haptic Fidgets: Tap, swipe, hold, shake, or tilt your device. Discover deeply satisfying interactions inspired by everyday life, including Bubble Wrap, Snap, Bounce, Buttons, and more.
- Feel Every Interaction: Powered by deep integration with your iPhone's advanced haptic engine, every click, pop, and slide is meticulously tuned to feel incredibly realistic.
- Works Out of the Box: Open the app and start fidgeting immediately with a beautifully intuitive interface.

ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION
- Make It Your Own: Adjust the size, color, animations, and behaviors of your favorite fidgets.
- Set the Mood: Choose from gorgeous premade themes or tweak the visuals to match your exact aesthetic.
- Share with Friends: Created the perfect fidget setup or custom theme? Share your configurations easily using custom links.

A TRULY PREMIUM FREE TIER
I hate ads just as much as you do. Fidgetable offers a generous free tier that includes all core fidgets and features with zero interruptions, zero data-selling, and zero paywalls on the essentials. It's just you and the app.

UNLOCK MORE WITH FIDGETABLE+
For power users who want to dive deeper and support a solo developer, Fidgetable+ is available as an affordable one-time purchase (or an even lower-cost yearly subscription) with Apple Family Sharing included!
- Custom Fidget Builder: Combine and edit existing components to build entirely new fidgets.
- Advanced Haptic Tuning: Dive deep and tweak the haptics to make them feel exactly how you want.
- Theme Builder: Complete control over your app's visual appearance.
- Alternate Modes: Unlock new behaviors for your favorite fidgets.
- Statistics: Learn more about how you use the app.

Built exclusively for iOS, Fidgetable takes full advantage of Apple's advanced haptic engine and frameworks to guarantee a perfectly consistent, high-fidelity tactile experience on your iPhone.

Fidgetable is designed and developed with love by an indie developer. If you enjoy the app, please consider leaving a rating!

Terms of Use: Fidgetable uses Apple’s standard EULA, available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fidgetable.app/privacy/
en.releaseNotes:
Introducing Slider, Fidgetable's newest fidget! Inspired by a ball on a spring, drag it up and down to watch and feel it bounce. Slider is free for everyone, and will be automatically added to your fidget list.

When customizing fidgets, you can now also undo/redo your changes if you misclick!

This update also fixed bugs and increased the overall stability of Fidgetable. It should be fast and streamlined as ever!
en.subtitle: Relax & destress with haptics

ja.description:
そわそわを、再発明。Fidgetableは、集中したり、リラックスしたり、触覚を通じたデジタルインタラクションの楽しさを味わったりするための、美しい触覚アプリです。iOS向けにシームレスに設計され、洗練されたデザインと驚くほど奥深いカスタマイズ性を融合。すぐに気持ちよく使える感覚体験を提供しながら、好みに合わせて自由自在に調整できます。

作業中のちょっとした気分転換が欲しいときも、とことんカスタマイズできる感覚ツールを探しているときも、Fidgetableなら指先に満足感のある触覚フィードバックを届けます。そして何より、広告は一切ありません。これからもずっと。

シンプルで満足感のある基本機能
- 12種類以上のユニークな触覚フィジェット：タップ、スワイプ、長押し、シェイク、デバイスの傾きなど、さまざまな操作を楽しめます。プチプチ、スナップ、バウンス、ボタンなど、日常の感覚に着想を得た、クセになるインタラクションを発見しましょう。
- すべての操作を感じる：iPhoneの高度な触覚エンジンと深く連携し、クリック、弾ける感覚、スライドの一つひとつを、驚くほどリアルに感じられるよう細部まで調整しています。
- すぐに使える：アプリを開いたら、美しく直感的なインターフェースですぐにそわそわ遊びを始められます。

無限のカスタマイズ
- 自分だけのスタイルに：お気に入りのフィジェットのサイズ、色、アニメーション、動作を調整できます。
- 雰囲気を演出：美しいプリセットテーマから選ぶことも、ビジュアルを細かく調整して理想のスタイルに合わせることもできます。
- 友達と共有：理想のフィジェット構成やカスタムテーマを作成したら、カスタムリンクで簡単に共有できます。

本当に充実した無料プラン
広告が嫌いなのは、あなたと同じです。Fidgetableの無料プランには、基本的なフィジェットと機能がすべて含まれており、利用中に邪魔されることも、データが販売されることも、必須機能にペイウォールが表示されることもありません。あなたとアプリだけの体験です。

FIDGETABLE+でもっと楽しむ
さらに深く楽しみたいパワーユーザーや、個人開発者を応援したい方には、Fidgetable+がおすすめです。お手頃な買い切り購入、またはさらに低価格な年額サブスクリプションで利用でき、Appleのファミリー共有にも対応しています。
- カスタムフィジェットビルダー：既存のコンポーネントを組み合わせて編集し、まったく新しいフィジェットを作成できます。
- 高度な触覚チューニング：触覚フィードバックを細部まで調整し、思いどおりの感触に仕上げられます。
- テーマビルダー：アプリのビジュアルを完全にコントロールできます。
- 代替モード：お気に入りのフィジェットに新しい動作を追加できます。
- 統計：アプリの使い方をより詳しく確認できます。

iOS専用に設計されたFidgetableは、Appleの高度な触覚エンジンとフレームワークを最大限に活用し、iPhoneで一貫した高精度の触覚体験を実現します。

Fidgetableは、個人開発者が愛情を込めて設計・開発しています。アプリを気に入っていただけたら、ぜひ評価をお願いします。

利用規約：FidgetableはAppleの標準EULAを使用しています。詳しくは以下をご覧ください。
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

プライバシーポリシー：
https://fidgetable.app/privacy/
ja.releaseNotes:
新しいフィジェット「スライダー」が登場しました。バネについたボールから着想を得たスライダーは、上下にドラッグすると、跳ねる様子を見たり、その感触を楽しんだりできます。スライダーは誰でも無料で利用でき、自動的にフィジェットリストへ追加されます。

フィジェットのカスタマイズ中に操作を間違えても、変更を元に戻したり、やり直したりできるようになりました。

このアップデートでは、いくつかの不具合を修正し、Fidgetable全体の安定性も向上しています。これまでどおり、素早くスムーズにお楽しみいただけます。

de.description:
Zappeln, neu gedacht. Fidgetable ist eine wunderschöne haptische App, die dir hilft, dich zu konzentrieren, zu entspannen und Freude an taktilen digitalen Interaktionen zu finden. Nahtlos für iOS entwickelt, verbindet sie elegantes Design mit überraschend umfangreichen Anpassungsmöglichkeiten und bietet dir ein beeindruckendes sensorisches Erlebnis direkt nach dem Öffnen, das du vollständig an deine Vorlieben anpassen kannst.

Ob du bei der Arbeit eine einfache Ablenkung brauchst oder ein individuell anpassbares sensorisches Tool suchst: Fidgetable bringt befriedigende haptische Rückmeldungen direkt an deine Fingerspitzen. Und das Beste daran? Es gibt absolut keine Werbung. Niemals.

EINFACHE UND BEFRIEDIGENDE GRUNDFUNKTIONEN
- Über 12 einzigartige haptische Fidgets: Tippe, wische, halte, schüttle oder neige dein Gerät. Entdecke besonders befriedigende Interaktionen, inspiriert vom Alltag, darunter Luftpolsterfolie, Schnappschalter, Hüpfen, Tasten und vieles mehr.
- Spüre jede Interaktion: Dank der tiefen Integration in die fortschrittliche haptische Engine deines iPhones ist jeder Klick, jedes Ploppen und jedes Gleiten sorgfältig abgestimmt und fühlt sich unglaublich realistisch an.
- Sofort einsatzbereit: Öffne die App und beginne direkt mit dem Fidgeting in einer wunderschönen, intuitiven Benutzeroberfläche.

ENDLOSE ANPASSUNGSMÖGLICHKEITEN
- Mach die App zu deiner eigenen: Passe Größe, Farbe, Animationen und Verhalten deiner Lieblings-Fidgets an.
- Schaffe die passende Stimmung: Wähle aus beeindruckenden vorgefertigten Designs oder passe die Darstellung an deine ganz persönlichen Vorlieben an.
- Mit Freunden teilen: Du hast das perfekte Fidget-Layout oder ein eigenes Design erstellt? Teile deine Konfigurationen ganz einfach über individuelle Links.

EINE WIRKLICH HOCHWERTIGE KOSTENLOSE VERSION
Ich hasse Werbung genauso sehr wie du. Fidgetable bietet eine großzügige kostenlose Version mit allen wichtigen Fidgets und Funktionen, ohne Unterbrechungen, ohne Verkauf deiner Daten und ohne Bezahlschranken bei den grundlegenden Funktionen. Nur du und die App.

MEHR MÖGLICHKEITEN MIT FIDGETABLE+
Für Power-User, die tiefer eintauchen und einen unabhängigen Entwickler unterstützen möchten, ist Fidgetable+ als günstiger Einmalkauf oder als noch kostengünstigeres Jahresabo erhältlich, inklusive Apple-Familienfreigabe.
- Eigener Fidget-Builder: Kombiniere und bearbeite vorhandene Komponenten, um völlig neue Fidgets zu erstellen.
- Erweiterte haptische Abstimmung: Passe die haptischen Rückmeldungen im Detail an, damit sie sich genau so anfühlen, wie du es möchtest.
- Design-Builder: Volle Kontrolle über das visuelle Erscheinungsbild der App.
- Alternative Modi: Schalte neue Verhaltensweisen für deine Lieblings-Fidgets frei.
- Statistiken: Erfahre mehr darüber, wie du die App nutzt.

Fidgetable wurde exklusiv für iOS entwickelt und nutzt Apples fortschrittliche haptische Engine und Frameworks vollständig aus, um ein durchgehend konsistentes, hochwertiges taktiles Erlebnis auf deinem iPhone zu gewährleisten.

Fidgetable wurde mit viel Liebe von einem unabhängigen Entwickler entwickelt. Wenn dir die App gefällt, hinterlasse bitte eine Bewertung.

Nutzungsbedingungen: Fidgetable verwendet Apples standardmäßige EULA, verfügbar unter https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutzerklärung: https://fidgetable.app/privacy/

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Welcome to the first significant Fidgetable update! Some notable improvements include:

- Apple Watch App
You can now access Fidgetable on your Apple Watch! Due to WatchKit limitations, there's currently only one fidget, but more customization features are on the way.

- Improved Theme System
Themes have been completely rebuilt from the ground up. The app will now respect your phone's color scheme, and themes now adapt to match.

- Custom App Icons
Each theme now has an associated app icon, so you can either match your app theme or customize your app icon to match your home screen!

- Improved Settings
The settings menu has been improved all over to make it easier to understand and navigate.

And, of course, there's plenty of general bug fixes and performance improvements.

Introducing Tilt, Fidgetable's newest fidget! It is designed to simulate the feeling of balancing a ball on top of your phone, and has been added to the end of the fidget list. Give it a shot, and feel free to share any feedback or ideas you have to improve Fidgetable through the settings menu.

Introducing Dial, Fidgetable's newest fidget! It is inspired by selection menus found across iOS apps, and has been added to the end of the fidget list. Give it a shot, and feel free to share any feedback or ideas you have to improve Fidgetable through the settings menu.

This is a hotfix for version 1.3. The dial fidget now functions properly on light theme.

Fidgetable now supports iOS 26 and Liquid Glass! This is the final build that will support iOS 17.

Welcome to Fidgetable v2! This is a massive update packed with new ways to fidget, deep customization, and an entirely new way to build your own interactions.

Here is what's new:

THREE BRAND NEW FIDGETS
- Snap: Drag the main handle around to small detents for satisfying snapping.
- Bubble Wrap: Tap or drag to pop the bubbles.
- Bounce: Tilt your phone or swipe the fidget to bounce the ball around.

A HUGE DESIGN OVERHAUL
Buttons, Vibrate, Pop, Shake, and Rotate have all received major design, animation, and haptic upgrades. They feel better and snappier than ever.

ADVANCED CUSTOMIZATION & SHARING
- You can now adjust the size, color, and appearance of most fidgets.
- Made something cool? You can now share your custom fidget configurations and themes directly with friends!
- A brand new Fidget Switcher makes jumping between your favorites incredibly fast.
- Completely overhauled settings menu with intuitive appearance customization.

INTRODUCING FIDGETABLE+ & THE CUSTOM FIDGET BUILDER
To help fund future development, I am introducing Fidgetable+! Don't worry: NO old features are being paywalled, and Fidgetable is still 100% ad-free. Fidgetable+ is an affordable one-time purchase (or low-cost subscription) for power users that unlocks:
- The Custom Fidget Builder: Combine and edit existing components to create completely new fidgets!
- Advanced Haptic Tuning: Tweak the haptics to feel exactly how you want.
- Theme Builder, alternate fidget behaviors, and early access to beta features (like the new Spinner fidget and sound effects).
- Family Sharing is fully supported!

Thank you to everyone who supports Fidgetable as a solo developer. If you enjoy the update, a quick rating or review means the world to me!

This hotfix for Fidgetable v2 focuses on improving your experience with translations.

Whats fixed:
- Corrected several translation issues so menus, buttons, and labels better match their intended meaning.
- Improved clarity in key areas of the app where text was confusing or inaccurate in certain languages.

New option:
- Added a toggle in Settings that lets you switch the entire app to English instantly.
- This is especially useful if you still notice translation problems, or if you simply prefer to use the app in English.

If you continue to see incorrect or awkward translations, you can now quickly switch to English and keep using Fidgetable without interruption while I work on polishing all language versions.

This update adds two major improvements designed to make the app feel more personal and more insightful.

Customizable handle locations:
You can now choose exactly where the fidget selector and menu handles appear on screen.  
Prefer everything closer to your thumb? Move both handles to the bottom for easier one-handed use.  
Want to swap their positions so your most-used handle is on your dominant side? You can do that too.  
Dial in what feels most natural for you in:
Settings > Customization > Navigation > Handle Locations.

Richer, clearer statistics for Plus users:
The stats page for Plus users has been completely redesigned to be cleaner and more elegant, and it now tracks more statistics as you use the app.

And as always
This update also includes a collection of behind-the-scenes improvements:
- Smoother performance in everyday use
- Fixes for several bugs reported by users
- Small interface refinements to make the app feel more polished and consistent
This patch for v2.1 fixes an issue where themes would sometimes not persist when the app is reopened.

This update focuses on bug fixes and performance optimizations. You should notice an overall smoother experience!

This update also adds additional privacy controls. As always, your data is yours, and only anonymous analytics are collected to help prioritize new features and catch bugs. If you prefer, though, you can disable these analytics in settings.

Introducing Slider, Fidgetable's newest fidget! Inspired by a ball on a spring, drag it up and down to watch and feel it bounce. Slider is free for everyone, and will be automatically added to your fidget list.

When customizing fidgets, you can now also undo/redo your changes if you misclick!

This update also fixed bugs and increased the overall stability of Fidgetable. It should be fast and streamlined as ever!
